target.title: Document OpenCode Go multi-workspace decision
target.body:
## Summary

- accepts automatic OpenCode Go workspace fan-out with stacked cards
- preserves the existing single-workspace override as an exact, no-fallback filter
- caps refreshes at 20 workspaces and four concurrent workspace pipelines
- requires deterministic identifier ordering, per-workspace failure isolation, shared in-memory credentials, and visible truncation
- blocks workspace-name persistence until authenticated response fields are proven

## Current shape

- OpenCode Go remains single-workspace at runtime; this PR is architecture only
- merged PR #1788 made weekly usage optional, which every future workspace snapshot must preserve independently
- implementation still requires redacted multi-workspace evidence, focused parser/model tests, packaged UI proof, and separate review

## Verification

- `make check`
- documentation links: 144 local links clean
- SwiftFormat: 0/1237 files require formatting
- SwiftLint: 0 violations in 1236 files

Docs only; no UI, networking, or credential behavior changed.
